summary: Lane County, OR site about 3 mi north of McKenzie Bridge in the Willamette NF; listed as abandoned with an alidade c.1935; now gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Oregon's index lists it as gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains on the site

events.note: An alidade was established at the site, c.1935, per the Forest Lookouts page

evidence.supports: location: 3 miles north of McKenzie Bridge
Oregon index: type unknown, status gone
lightning struck a Lookout Mountain about 4 miles NE of McKenzie Bridge and started the Lookout Fire (not linked to this site in the source)
evidence.quote: lightning struck on Lookout Mountain, about 4 miles NE of McKenzie Bridge, at 5pm and started the Lookout Fire.

evidence.supports: Lookout Fire began with a lightning strike on Saturday, August 5, 2023, inside the H.J. Andrews Experimental Forest
evidence.quote: A lightning strike fire started on Saturday, August 5, within the H.J. Andrews Experimental Forest

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three listings, no structure details, no height, no photos, no staffing or access information. The 1930s date is given without a year, so no built year is recorded. Lane County, Willamette NF and the 3 mi north of McKenzie Bridge location agree across firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page; the index coordinates match the brief. The 2023 Lookout Fire appears in the story only as a hedged sentence: the McKenzie Bridge community center says lightning hit a Lookout Mountain about 4 mi NE of town, and the Andrews timeline dates the start to Saturday, August 5, 2023, but neither source ties it to this lookout site, so no fire event is recorded. A different, standing Lookout Mountain (82 ft tower, elevation 5,229 ft, reached via Road 370) appeared in search results on cherylhill.net and was not used because it is not this gone site. Budget: 2 WebSearch rounds; about 9 page reads, several being repeat greps of the same firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts pages.
